title: AI Engineer (Generative AI)
summary: An AI engineer builds product features on top of large language models (LLMs), the models behind chat assistants. They sit in a product or platform engineering team and turn a model into a reliable feature, using retrieval (RAG, where the model looks up your own documents before answering), tools and checks on answer quality.
dailyDuties: Write and refine prompts for LLM features
Build RAG pipelines that chunk documents, create embeddings and load them into a vector database
Build agents that call tools and internal APIs
Run evaluation sets to measure answer quality and catch hallucinations
Expose LLM features as APIs, often with FastAPI, and ship them in containers to the cloud
Fine-tune or host an open model when prompting is not enough
Review teammates' code in shared repositories
